items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: He says he played piano in the same house with Mamie Desdune and he got this piece from her

ctx.x: I'll bring it out sometime. Mamie's Blues tunes, the old 219 blues, was that originally Jelly's tune too?

No, it was Mamie's Jelly's tune too, originally. That's the funny thing about that. A guy picked that up in London and had permission to put it in his book and comment. He was a very high class musicologist. They called him talented musician and musicologist, I believe. Anyhow, he put that in and he made comments on it, you know, and he commented on Jelly Roll and so forth. And he went on to say, says Jelly Roll, born in 1896.
